buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 5. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 6. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 7. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 8. Past Project Experience The Bidder / OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)}, should have executed project for supply and

installation / commissioning of same or similar Category Products during preceding 3 financial years (i.e. current year and three previous financial years) as on opening of bid, as per following criteria: (i) Single order of at least 35% of estimated bid value; or (ii) Two orders of at least 20% each of estimated bid value; or (iii) Three orders of at least 15% each of estimated bid value. Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid. In case of bunch bids, the Category related to primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion 9. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Term & Condition: 1. As India per to Govt. of India program(MEITY), The product manufacturer must have manufacturing facili ty in INDIA to promote “MAKE IN INDIA” and declaration certificate for the same. 2. Manufacturer/OEM/Bidder should submit LM79 test report, TDS report and IP65/ IP66/IP67 Protection Re port. 3. Manufacturer/OEM/Bidder should have BIS registration certificate and each LED light should be BIS Certified. 4. As per Govt. Act., Fittings should have CRS No.(Compulsory Registration Scheme) from BIS as per IS sta ndard. 5. Bidder shall be authorized by the OEM & certificate for participating in the tender is mandatory to been closed with the bid documents. Bid Specific Authorisation is mandatory. 6. Manufacturer/OEM/Bidder must submit 5 years warranty and Guarantee certificate on Notarized Stamp paper of 100/-Rs. 7. Manufacturer/OEM/Bidder have to submit one sample of the 200W LED fixture before opening the tender . 8. Manufacturer/OEM/Bidder should upload GST, PAN, CHARACTER CERTIFICATE, ADHAR, SOLVENCY CERTI FICATE, LABOUR CERTIFICATE and MSME CERTIFICATE etc. 9. Manufacturer/OEM/Bidder should upload Non-Back listed Notarized Stamp of 100/-Rs. 10. CA Certified turnover certificate for last 3 financial years, or Audited balance sheet of last 3 years to be uploaded mention UDIN number with minimum 75%of bid value not more than 6 month. 11. CA Certified Net worth Certificate to be Uploaded. 12. ITR documents of last 3 Years to be uploaded. 13. Service centre details and Flood Light(LED) Sample Should be Submitted along with hard copy of EMD i n the Nagar Panchayat Mariahu Office. 14. Character certificate verified from DM of the District. 15. EMD 5% of the bid/tender value favoring Executive officer Nagar Panchayat Mariahu Office to the sub mitted along with hard copy submitted in the office during official time. 16. The Contractors/bidders must be authorized by the respective OEM to participate in the tender and the certificate must be enclosed with the bidder's documents. 17. ISO Certificate of OEM & Bidder both should be submitted with the bid. 18. The Bidder must provide authorization of Floodlight Lighting Manufacturer (OEM) and Highmast Manufa cturer (OEM) mentioning the Bid Numbers and Validity. 19. PWD Approval Certificate of OEM for Floodlight and Highmast needs to be uploaded. Only AAA

Category of Streetlight is accepted. 20. Valid Haisiyat Praman Patr issued by DM or Solvency Certificate issued by Bank should be uploaded. 21. NABL Certificate of OEM to be uploaded. 22. OEM should have In-house Manufacturing Unit for Drivers. In case the drivers are being outsourced fro m some other company, then TDS, TTC Report of Driver, Service Centre Details, Warranty Certificate, ITR & Balance Sheet of the company manufacturing the Driver should also be uploaded. 23. Details of Technical Employees (Wireman & Supervisor) should be mentioned by the bidder on Bidder’ s Letter Head and the same should be uploaded with the bid. 24. Bidders are advised to refer to the Estimate containing all details of Work to be done attached in Additi onal Scope of Work, before participating. The work details mentioned in the same are to be done. .
